usage: Use 拔草 when you mean pulling unwanted weeds out of the ground by hand or with a small tool.
This is a very common gardening action word, often used for keeping a garden, pot, or yard tidy.
It can be used in simple everyday instructions, like talking about chores, farm work, or school gardening activities.
The word is neutral and straightforward; it usually focuses on removing weeds, not general cleaning or digging.
